question: Who had gained the citizens’ trust by the time they cursed Abimelek at the festival?

readings.support: Gaal son of Ebed | its citizens put their confidence in him

assessments.reason: Verse 26 explicitly says “Gaal son of Ebed … and its citizens put their confidence in him,” prior to the festival where they cursed Abimelek, so he had their trust by that time.

reason: The text states the citizens put their confidence in Gaal son of Ebed before the festival where they cursed Abimelek.
